title: Moss and the Den
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters gl, gr, pl.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog standing at the base of a big old oak tree.
Moss spotting a thin twig lying on the ground near the oak tree’s roots.
Moss finding a sturdy stick lying among the oak tree’s roots.
Moss finding a flat grey rock near the oak tree.
Moss propping the sturdy stick upright against one of the big oak roots.
Moss resting the flat grey rock on top of the stick to form a little roof.
The finished little den, made from the stick and rock, nestled among the oak roots.
Moss the hedgehog curled up asleep inside the little den.
Moss the hedgehog sitting happily beside his finished den.
